items.title: First Run, Oshodi to Ikeja
items.blurb: Sule's driver no show. Carry the yellow bus to Ikeja, call the stops, collect the fares.

call.line: My driver no show and the bus dey park. Come Oshodi, carry am go Ikeja. You go collect your share.

lines: Ah, you reach. See the bus, the one with the cracked mirror. She get temper but she dey go.
Shout the route, no overload, no fight. Park Ikeja side, I go collect my own.
steps.text: Meet Conductor Sule at Oshodi Park

steps.prompt: A rival conductor blocks the bus door. "This bus na for my line! Pay park fee or find another road."

steps.text: Run the Oshodi to Ikeja line
He shoved you off the door. Get out of the park.

steps.title: THROWN OUT
steps.text: The rival conductors ran you off the line.
Run the line, no stopping for them

items.title: Rush Hour at Oshodi
items.blurb: Morning rush. Two runs to Mushin and back before the park fills up.

call.line: Rush hour don start. Fares go double, the bus dey wait. Make you come now now.

lines: Everybody dey rush. If you carry full bus the first run, I go give you extra.

steps.prompt: "Driver! My stop is back there. Abeg turn around, I go pay double."

options.text: Turn around, take the double fare
Ignore him. The line is the line.

items.title: Toll at Mafoluku
items.blurb: Area boys have started a toll at Mafoluku. Pay, charm them or break it up.

giver.name: Conductor Sule
giver.line: Those boys for Mafoluku don start collect toll. Settle am for me, I no care how.

steps.text: Go to Mafoluku terminal and see what they want

lines: This place get owner. Every bus wey pass, ₦2,000. No be me talk am, na the chairman.
You go see am. After you pay.

steps.prompt: He folds his arms. Three of his friends step closer.

items.title: Night Shift to Ikotun
items.blurb: The last bus to Ikotun pays well, and so does trouble. Watch who enters after ten.

call.line: Last bus for Ikotun side, nobody wan carry am. Fares dey sweet but shine your eye.

lines: Night run. People dey enter that bus for one chance reason. If dem look wrong, stop and shout.

steps.prompt: A man in a black cap leans to the window at Ejigbo. "Oga, small detour. I pay five thousand for the trouble."

options.text: Read him: does he look right?

steps.text: Take the man where he wants. Keep your eyes open.
He had friends. Fight them off

items.title: Okada: First Day at Computer Village
items.blurb: Borrow an okada and ferry phone buyers around the Computer Village alleys.

giver.name: Baba Rider
giver.line: You fit ride? Take this bike, bring ₦1,500 for me daily. Whatever else you collect na yours.

lines: The bike get small problem with the brake. Press hard. Passengers no go know.

items.title: Rider Union Dues
items.blurb: The riders union wants its dues, today. Collect from four riders, or pay yourself.

giver.name: Chairman Alade
giver.line: Dues na dues. You go round collect from four boys, or you go pay for them. Your choice.

lines: Four spots: Ikeja Along, Mafoluku, Mushin and Ojota. Some of them go fight you. Eh. Na work.

steps.prompt: The last rider says his bike is down and he has no money. His eyes say he is lying.

items.title: Okada Ban Zone
items.blurb: An okada ban covers Ikeja this week. Deliver a passenger through it without getting caught.

call.line: LASTMA don block everywhere. I get passenger for Ikeja side, he pay ₦12,000. You fit pass?

lines: I get meeting at Alausa. No time for traffic.
They say bikes dey banned, but I no get choice. Go through the back streets.

steps.text: Go through Allen with the passenger
LASTMA spotted the bike. Lose them

items.title: Madam in the Keke
items.blurb: A GRA madam wants a keke for the morning: hair salon, church, market. Complaints included.

giver.name: Mama Gbemi
giver.line: Young man, you drive this keke gently, abi? My wig is not free.

lines: First the salon at Opebi, then church, then you wait while I buy fish.
Do not honk. I am not a goat.

steps.prompt: She sniffs at the keke. "Thank you. Now tell me honestly. Did you enjoy the job?"

items.title: Wedding Party to Festac
items.blurb: Six aso-ebi aunties, three kekes needed, one nervous bride. You are the only keke available.

giver.name: Aunty Ngozi
giver.line: The wedding starts in forty minutes and the bride dey cry. Abeg, carry us!

lines: We go Trade Fair side. The hall is there. Move move move!

steps.text: Take the wedding party to Trade Fair

steps.prompt: The bride says she forgot the cake at home. Everyone looks at you.

options.text: Make a quick run back to Festac

steps.text: Stop at the baker near Alaba Rago
Deliver the party and the cake

items.title: BRT Lane, Full Bus
items.blurb: The BRT lane is empty only when you do not need it. Drive the express from Ketu to TBS.

giver.name: Mr. Ola
giver.line: The express bus has no driver. Drive it clean, no scraping the barrier, no stopping for hawkers.

lines: Quick stops, quick loading. People are watching the clock.

steps.text: Run the BRT line, Ketu to TBS

items.title: Third Mainland Commute
items.blurb: A bus-load of office workers and a jam on the bridge. Get them to the Island.

call.line: Third Mainland job. The jam dey there but fare dey high. Come Gbagada.

steps.text: Run Gbagada to Obalende across the bridge

steps.prompt: Midspan, traffic stops dead. A man in a suit leans in: "I go be late. Park and let me jump out, I pay you triple."

options.text: Let him down on the bridge

items.title: Airport Pickup
items.blurb: A returnee lands at MMIA. He wants a clean car, a driver who knows Ikoyi, and no talking.

call.line: My cousin land from London. Pick him at Terminal 1 and take him to Ikoyi. Sedan or SUV, nothing small.

steps.text: Pick up the passenger at MMIA Terminal 1

lines: Eyah, the heat. Is the AC working? No? Of course not.
Ikoyi, please. I will direct you when we reach Falomo.

steps.prompt: "The traffic is mad. Is there another way?"

steps.text: You are early. Deliver him to Ikoyi

items.title: Hospital Dash
items.blurb: A woman is in labour at Mushin and the road is blocked. Get her to the hospital on the bike, now.

giver.name: Frightened husband
giver.line: My wife dey labour! Okada, please, General Hospital!

lines: She is here! Carry her, abeg abeg.

steps.text: Ride to Mushin General Hospital, fast

steps.title: TOO LATE
steps.text: The baby came on the road. Mother and child are alright, but you were slow.

items.title: Overload
items.blurb: The bus is overloaded and a checkpoint sits at Ladipo. Hide, bribe, or bluff.

steps.text: Approach Ladipo and see the checkpoint

steps.prompt: "Oga driver. I count twenty-two. Plate says eighteen. You know the law?"

steps.text: The officers want you. Lose them

items.title: Jollof Run
items.blurb: Mama Put has a hot pot of jollof for a customer across the road and nobody to carry it. Do not let it go cold.

call.line: My pikin, take this food go customer for me. I go pay you well. And you still owe me ₦500, I never forget.

giver.name: Mama Put
giver.line: You, come here! Carry this food for my customer. Hot hot, no waiting.

lines: Three packs of jollof and a chicken. Customer dey wait at Oshodi Terminal 3. Fast, before the oil settles.
steps.text: Collect the food from Mama Put
Take the food to the customer at Terminal 3

items.title: Parcel, No Questions
items.blurb: A small package, a far address, and police who seem to know about it. Do not open it.

call.line: I get small package. No ask question. Police dey around, so shine your eye.

lines: Do not open it. Do not lose it. Do not talk to anybody in uniform.
The man at Ikeja Along go call you. Move.
steps.text: Meet the contact under the bridge

steps.prompt: A police car slows beside you. The officer waves you over.

steps.text: Take the parcel to Ikeja Along
Hand it to the man at Ikeja Along
Lose the police with the parcel
You got away. Deliver the parcel to Ikeja Along
Hand it to the man at Ikeja Along

steps.title: ARRESTED
steps.text: The parcel was taken. Somebody will be asking about it.
You are in trouble. Get away from here.
Lose the heat before you continue
Hand it to the man at Ikeja Along

items.title: Phones for the Shops
items.blurb: Boxes of phones and chargers need to reach four shops before the Ikeja traders close.

giver.name: Alhaji Musa
giver.line: Four boxes, four shops. If one phone goes missing, I know your face.

lines: Plaza bank, bus terminal, the station and Otigba alley. In that order.

steps.text: Deliver along the Computer Village dispatch route
Hand the last box to the shop

items.title: Brake Pads for Papa Ajao
items.blurb: A mechanic at Papa Ajao has a taxi on the lift waiting for brake pads from Ladipo. Fifteen minutes or he loses the customer.

giver.name: Madam Bisi
giver.line: Pads for Pa Ajao, urgent. Ladipo no wait, you no wait, we all no wait.

lines: Genuine, not fake. Tell Pa Ajao the stamp is under the box.
steps.text: Collect the pads from Madam Bisi

steps.title: TOO SLOW
steps.text: The customer drove off. Pa Ajao is not happy.

items.title: Fish from Makoko
items.blurb: Fresh fish from the Makoko canoes to Oyingbo market before the sun spoils it.

giver.name: Mama Tolu
giver.line: The fish is still jumping. Take am go Oyingbo before it start to smell.

lines: Cool box, ice, and no stopping. The market women pay for fresh.

steps.prompt: The ice is melting fast. Heat today is wicked.

options.text: Stop by Ebute Metta for ice (₦1,500)

steps.text: Hand the cooler to the buyer
Hand the cooler to the buyer

steps.title: FISH SPOILED
steps.text: The market woman held her nose and refused. Nobody likes this smell.

items.title: Cake for the Reception
items.blurb: A three-tier cake and a hall in GRA. Take the corners gently. The bride has a temper.

giver.name: Chef Tola
giver.line: Three tiers, two hundred thousand naira, and no pothole is your friend. Drive like it is your own child.

lines: Your max speed today is walking pace. Good luck.

steps.text: Take a car, not an okada
Drive carefully to the GRA reception hall
Hand the cake to the bridesmaids

steps.title: LATE CAKE
steps.text: The reception started without cake. The aunties will remember.

items.title: Cement for Ayobo
items.blurb: A site in Ayobo needs twenty bags of cement. The area boys at the site will ask for something.

giver.name: Engineer Dayo
giver.line: The cement lorry is stuck at Egbeda. Collect and bring. The onile will want money, tell them it is paid.

lines: Go to Egbeda, the yellow lorry. Bring it here by the main road.

steps.text: Find the cement lorry at Egbeda

steps.prompt: Three young men step out. "Everything that goes into this land, we get a share. ₦15,000."

steps.text: Hand the cement to the foreman
Hand the cement to the foreman

items.title: Night Pharmacy
items.blurb: A child has a fever and the only pharmacy with the right syrup is in Ikeja. The ward is in Mushin.

call.line: Please, the ward has run out of the syrup. HealthPlus at Ikeja has it. Anybody who can ride, come now.

steps.text: Collect the syrup at HealthPlus Ikeja

steps.prompt: The pharmacist hesitates. "I need to see a prescription."

steps.text: Hand the syrup to Nurse Joy
Hand the syrup to Nurse Joy

items.title: Gas for the Estate
items.blurb: Gas is scarce and the estate women want cylinders. Light is out too, so find the street in the dark.

giver.name: Landlady Kemi
giver.line: No gas, no cooking, no peace. Bring us four cylinders. NEPA took light again so do not hit anybody.

lines: Isolo filling plant, the one by the NNPC. Return before the generators die.

steps.text: Go to the gas plant by the NNPC station, Isolo

items.title: Papers for Alausa
items.blurb: Land documents that must be stamped before the secretariat closes. Traffic is not your excuse.

giver.name: Barrister Femi
giver.line: Documents. Stamped today or my client loses his plot. Please move.

lines: The Surveyor General office, not the secretariat. People always confuse them.

steps.text: Go to the Surveyor General office, Alausa

steps.prompt: The clerk glances at the clock. "It is 3:30. We close at 4. The queue is long."

options.text: Say you are with the Barrister

items.title: Tomato Flip
items.blurb: Tomatoes are cheap at Mile 12 and dear at Oshodi. Buy a basket, carry it, sell it before it goes soft.

giver.name: Mama Nkechi
giver.line: Tomatoes dey cost money in Oshodi. Go Mile 12, buy for me and sell for the park. Keep the difference.

lines: Take ₦4,000 from my own pocket. If you waste it, I know where you sleep.
steps.text: Collect the capital from Mama Nkechi
Carry them to Oshodi before they soften
Sell the tomatoes at the park

steps.title: NO DEAL
steps.text: You walked away. The money goes back to Mama Nkechi.

items.title: Yam by the Truck
items.blurb: A trailer of yams arrives at Mile 12. Buy cheap, sell in lots at Mushin and Agege.

giver.name: Alhaji Danjuma
giver.line: The trailer just reach. If you have eyes for numbers, you fit eat from this.

lines: I sell twenty tubers for ₦9,000 but you must carry yourself. Two markets: Mushin first, then Agege.

steps.text: You need a vehicle to move the load

steps.title: NO BUYER
steps.text: You carry the yams around Lagos and nobody wants them. Danjuma takes his loss.

items.title: Tokunbo Tyres
items.blurb: Used tyres from Ladipo, sold to Cappa mechanics. Feel the tread before you pay.

giver.name: Chief Ebuka
giver.line: I get four tokunbo tyres that nobody has time to sell. Buy, flip, we share the smile.

lines: Look at this one. Almost new. Tokunbo from Germany. Maybe Idumota, but the tread is real.

steps.prompt: Four tyres, ₦12,000. Inspect first, or trust me?

items.title: Refurb Phones
items.blurb: Buy dead phones, fix three of them in the alley, sell them as good second-hand.

giver.name: Oga Tunde
giver.line: Dead phones, bag of ten. Fix three of them, sell to the guy by the bank. Very easy money.

steps.text: Find a table to work at

items.title: Ankara from Idumota
items.blurb: Bolts of Ankara from the Island market to a boutique in Ikeja. The tailors upstairs love the colour.

giver.name: Madam Funmi
giver.line: Wax print for my boutique in Ikeja. Go to the wholesaler, bargain hard, and come back with fabric.

lines: Four bolts, ₦28,000 max. The wholesaler is in the third row. Do not buy faded ones.

steps.text: Drive to the boutique near Ikeja City Mall

steps.title: NO DEAL
steps.text: You walked away, and Funmi will never trust you with money again.

items.title: Pure Water Round
items.blurb: Sell sachet water at four busy stops. Hot day, thirsty crowd, small profit every time.

giver.name: Auntie Sade
giver.line: Pure water, cold cold. Take the bag and walk the stops. I don dey tire.

lines: Oshodi, Mafoluku, Ilupeju and Isolo. Say "pure water, cold" and smile.

items.title: Price War
items.blurb: Two onion sellers have a price war at Mushin market. Both want you on their side.

giver.name: Mama Kudi
giver.line: That woman across the road is selling below cost to kill me. Help me.

lines: She price at ₦700 a bag. Cost is ₦850. I am done if you do nothing.
Kudi is the one starting trouble. She has been robbing the market for years.

steps.prompt: The whole row is watching you.

options.text: Persuade both to agree a fair price

steps.text: It turns into a scuffle. Separate them

steps.title: YOU STAYED OUT
steps.text: No money for a man who does not pick sides in Lagos.

items.title: Charcoal Haul
items.blurb: Bags of charcoal from the Iddo wharf to restaurants on the mainland. The lorry broke down, so you drive.

giver.name: Baba Charcoal
giver.line: The lorry don die. You get car? Carry thirty bags to the mainland and I pay you.

items.title: Garri for Ikotun
items.blurb: Garri is expensive on the western side. Move three sacks from Ketu to Ikotun and keep the margin.

giver.name: Iya Garri
giver.line: Garri on this side is cheap, on the Ikotun side is gold. Go sell for me.

items.title: Okrika Bale
items.blurb: A bale of second-hand clothes opens at Tejuosho. Pick the good ones and flip them on campus.

giver.name: Uncle Sam
giver.line: The bale just open. Quick quick, the best jeans go first.

items.title: Genuine or Fake?
items.blurb: A stall owner offers you a load of fake brake pads. Selling them is easy money. Someone may get hurt.

giver.name: Oga Kunle
giver.line: I get something for you. Genuine packaging, you know. No questions.

lines: Fifty sets. Same box as the real thing. Cheap cheap, you can triple your money.

options.text: Buy and sell the fakes (₦6,000 cost)
Report him to the mechanics union

sell.label: a set of fifty brake pads

items.title: Alaba Electronics
items.blurb: Televisions, speakers and fans from Alaba to the Ikeja shops. Mind the bumps and the customs men.

giver.name: Chinedu
giver.line: The container just opened. Ten flat screens. Take them to Ikeja and I give you a cut.

steps.text: You need a vehicle with space

steps.title: NO DEAL
steps.text: You walked away with nothing but sore feet.
